race.title: StoneX Southern National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Prolific in handicap hurdles last season, MASK OF ZORRO picked up where he left off when making a successful transition to chasing at Newton Abbot (3¼m) 18 days ago. Totally unexposed at marathon trips and hailing from a stable who continue in rude health, this dual course winner looks a major player again. Jeu d'Opale tackles a much longer trip on return but appeals as being on a good mark, with last year's winner Livin On Luco and hat-trick seeker Paper Mill also shortlisted. MASK OF ZORRO (IRE) JEU D'OPALE (FR) LIVIN ON LUCO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mask Of Zorro (3/1), Call Me Legend (4/1), Paper Mill (9/2), Jeu D'opale (11/2), Livin On Luco (15/2), Ivane (11/1), Jack's Jury (12/1), Invincible Nao (20/1), Ventura Highway (25/1), Dartan (40/1), What A Glance (50/1)
